_readme: Durable ledger of every CDK stack this repo has deployed — the record that
must NOT be lost when the code changes. When a stack is renamed or replaced,
the old entry stays here (status: retiring|retired) with the physical
resources that outlive `cdk destroy`, so it is always clear what the old
stack owns and how it gets removed. New entries are added the moment a stack
is (re)named in infra/app.ts.
Why this exists: RemovalPolicy.RETAIN + deletionProtection resources (the
DynamoDB tables, the photos bucket) survive a stack delete as UNMANAGED
orphans, and standalone resources (hand-provisioned SSM params, old
CloudFront distributions, Lambda log groups) are never in the template at
all. Once the CDK code stops referencing an old stack there is no other
machine-readable trace of what it left behind. This file is that trace.
Consumers:
- decommissionStack.mjs --name <name>  reads the matching entry's `orphans`
and idempotently sweeps them after `cdk destroy`.
- verifyDecommission.mjs --name <name>  reads it for the read-only checks.
- ../commission/commissionStack.mjs --name <name>  the inverse: deploys the
stack with --import-existing-resources so surviving orphans are ADOPTED
(not recreated) — bring a stack up over prior data with no loss.
- ../commission/verifyCommission.mjs --name <name>  read-only: confirms each
orphan is now a resource OF the stack (managed).
- test/infra/stack-ledger.test.ts synthesizes the app and FAILS if any
RETAIN resource in the template is missing from the live/planned entry's
orphans (so you cannot add a retained resource, or rename a stack,
without recording it here).
status: live = deployed & current | planned = in code, not yet deployed |
retiring = superseded, decommission pending | retired = deleted & swept.
orphans list PHYSICAL names (region-scoped). ssmParams / cloudfrontDistributions
/ logGroupPrefixes are not stack resources — they are recorded by hand.
The AWS account is deliberately NOT recorded here (this file is committed):
it comes from AWS_ACCOUNT_ID in the ignored repo-root `.env.deploy` — see
`.env.deploy.example` and lib/awsCli.mjs's resolveAccount().

stacks.name: slackline-timer-v1
stacks.description: Backend: WS relay + HTTP competition data plane + photo CDN. Kebab-case stack-name rename of SlacklineTimerV1Stack.
stacks.notes: SSM params are hand-provisioned (ADR 0025), not stack-owned, so they survive independently — keep them across the rename (the physical names are unchanged); only delete on a true teardown.

stacks.name: slackline-timer-v1-web
stacks.description: Web frontend: private S3 bucket + CloudFront (OAC). Kebab-case stack-name rename of SlacklineTimerV1WebStack.
stacks.notes: The UI bucket is RemovalPolicy.DESTROY + autoDeleteObjects and CloudFront is stack-owned, so `cdk destroy` removes everything — no orphan sweep needed. eu-central-1 CDKToolkit must stay (this stack needs it).

stacks.name: slackline-timer-v1-billing
stacks.description: Cost backstop (ADR 0031 §1): monthly AWS Budget (€50) + a CloudWatch EstimatedCharges alarm → an SNS email topic. In us-east-1 because that is the only region publishing the AWS/Billing EstimatedCharges metric.
stacks.notes: No RETAIN/standalone resources — the SNS topic, CfnBudget, CloudWatch alarm, and the default-OFF CLOUDFRONT WAF WebACL (ADR 0031 §5, gated on the WafEnabled parameter; CloudFront-scope WAF is us-east-1-only, hence it rides this stack) are all stack-owned and removed by `cdk destroy`. us-east-1 CDKToolkit must be bootstrapped for this stack. The email subscription (the `billingAlertEmail` CDK context value) must be confirmed once via the SNS confirmation link after the first deploy.

stacks.name: SlacklineTimerV1Stack
stacks.description: Pre-rename backend stack (PascalCase name). Superseded by slackline-timer-v1. Decommissioned 2026-07-04.
stacks.notes: Retired 2026-07-04 via the data-preserving rename: deleted with -StackOnly (RETAIN tables/bucket kept), then ADOPTED into slackline-timer-v1 via --import-existing-resources (Commission-Stack.ps1) — NOT swept, no data loss. The /slackline-timer-v1/* SSM params were kept (the live stack reuses them). Kept here as history.

stacks.name: SlacklineTimerV1WebStack
stacks.description: Pre-rename web stack (PascalCase name). Superseded by slackline-timer-v1-web. Decommissioned 2026-07-04.
stacks.notes: Bucket DESTROY + autoDelete, CloudFront stack-owned — `cdk destroy` was clean (no orphans). Replaced by slackline-timer-v1-web (new CloudFront domain d2ea6ot00po74u.cloudfront.net); the old callback/logout URL d1wn2smh1769k2.cloudfront.net was removed from the Cognito app client. Kept here as history.

stacks.name: SpeedlineStack
stacks.notes: Fully swept 2026-07-03 (legacy speedline decommission). Kept here as history.

stacks.name: speedline-timer-prod
stacks.description: Legacy pre-CDK Serverless app (old WS relay + its own table + web bucket + IAM). Decommissioned 2026-07-03.
stacks.notes: Fully swept 2026-07-03 (legacy speedline decommission; E4GA3LNGDFWGF was a standalone old-frontend distribution, not stack-owned). Kept here as history.
